name: Influenza, RSV, Measles, Mumps, Rubella and Coronaviruses

reference.source: Paniker's Textbook of Medical Parasitology 8th Ed + Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic maps; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: H with N drift yearly, shift rarely
Steeple croup mists; RSV bronchiolitis oxygens
Koplik heralds measles; vitamin A halves deaths
reference.pathophysiology: Segment reassortment spawns pandemic H/N pairs while measles SLAM receptor lymphopenia erases immune memory; RSV F protein fuses airway cells into syncytia, and rubella arrests organogenesis into cataract-deafness-heart triads.
additionalDifferentials: Croup versus epiglottitis by bark, drool and films
Measles versus Kawasaki by Koplik and cough
RSV versus asthma by age, season and first wheeze
additionalInvestigations: Rapid flu antigen or PCR in season
RSV antigen with oximetry in bronchiolitis
Measles IgM with vitamin A protocol in outbreaks
